title: Hollandish Dutch Chicken Bowl
description: Peppery and pillowy, this Dutch dish features chicken drumsticks and a stone-bowl dolsot, making it a show-stopper at the dinner table. This Whole30-friendly recipe is perfect for a weeknight dinner or special occasion.
instructions: Season the chicken drumsticks with salt, black pepper, and smoked paprika.

Heat 1 tablespoon of avocado oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Sear the chicken drumsticks until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes per side. Transfer the chicken to a baking sheet and bake in the oven for 20-25 minutes, or until cooked through.

While the chicken is baking, heat the remaining 1 tablespoon of avocado oil in a small saucepan over medium heat. Add the gochujang and cook, stirring constantly, for 1-2 minutes. Stir in the lime juice and cook for an additional 1-2 minutes.
In a small bowl, mix together the shredded Dutch Gouda cheese and chopped scallions.

To assemble the bowls, place a few pieces of the cooked chicken on the bottom of a stone-bowl dolsot. Top with a spoonful of the gochujang-lime sauce, followed by a sprinkle of the cheese-scallion mixture. Garnish with additional parsley and serve immediately.
